name: IgroMir
blurb: Russia's largest video-game expo; its 2025 revival has since merged into the joint Comic Con Игромир festival.
notes: Duplicate of comic-con-russia in this batch. igromir.ru is now a parked/for-sale domain (extract.mjs home pass returned a DomainParking.ru placeholder page, no event content). WebSearch confirms IgroMir's revived event has merged brands with Comic Con Russia into one combined festival, 'Comic Con Игромир', Dec 3-6 2026 at Timiryazev Center, Moscow (afisha.yandex.ru, cybersport.ru, dtf.ru all describe one joint festival, not two separate shows). That 2026 edition and its guests are recorded under comic-con-russia.json; marking this entry inactive rather than duplicating the same edition/guests under a second id. Cover left null per the 'no reachable official image' allowance since the brand's own site no longer carries one (status is inactive here so a cover is not otherwise required, but noting explicitly since checked).
